selection: stable descending external credit per active head 0..254; head 255 never selected
resident_state: last-token 128D per head in a 255 x 128 host transport bank
paging: existing 16-slot LRU HeadPageLoader; one page resident per selected head

tensor_transport.last_token_path: HeadVector128 last-token leaf + guest last-token lane 0 scalar
tensor_transport.per_token_path: one HeadVector128 leaf per worker token, logical id base + head*6 + token, plus one guest last-token scalar per head
tensor_transport.active_policy: candidate-only; ACTIVE untouched until existing promotion gate

provenance: authenticated source SHA-256 and candidate generation
failure_policy: worker/page/generation failure rejects the batch; staging aborts the candidate on any late failure
note: Host selects and transports only; attention, QKV, LayerNorm and MLP are guest-side.
